title: Saudi Arabia ramps up oil exports through Mediterranean pipeline to avoid attacks in Red Sea
summary_full: Oil exports from Egypt's Mediterranean port of Sidi Kerir have more than doubled. The crude is mostly from Saudi Arabia, according to Kpler.
